verdict_reason: New coverage for the created/amendment-requested/cancelled/deleted/versionId events is thorough and correct, but the resubmit-from-AMEND path (the other headline mis-mapping this ticket fixes) has no IT assertion of its NotificationSubmissionAmended event type, and one carried-over test's name now contradicts its own body.

todos.issue: submitFromAmend_shouldClearSubmittedBaseline exercises the AMEND -> SUBMITTED resubmit path but never asserts the emitted outbox event type; no IT test in this file verifies that a resubmission emits NotificationSubmissionAmended, which is the second of the two mis-mapped transitions this ticket exists to fix and every other corrected/added transition got a dedicated envelope assertion in this diff
todos.fix: Add assertions (or a new test) verifying the outbox event written on resubmit from AMEND has eventType NotificationSubmissionAmended and the matching schemaUrl, mirroring amend_shouldWriteOutboxEventWithCorrectEnvelope's pattern for the SUBMITTED -> AMEND transition

todos.issue: submit_shouldReturn400_andEmitNothing_whenAReferencedPartyCannotBeResolved no longer matches its own body: a NOTIFICATION_CREATED event is now emitted on notification creation, and the test's own comment says so ('NOTIFICATION_CREATED was written when the draft was created'), contradicting the method name's 'andEmitNothing'
todos.fix: Rename to something like submit_shouldReturn400_andEmitNoSubmittedEvent_whenAReferencedPartyCannotBeResolved so the method name matches what it now asserts
